sources.snippet: Smaug arrives! We recently released Smaug-72B-v0.1 which has taken first place on the Open LLM Leaderboard by HuggingFace. With an average accuracy of 80.48%, it is the first open-source model to surpass an average score of 80%, and it is nearly 2% better than the next-best open-source model. We also released Smaug-34B-v0.1, the best 34B model at the time of its release. We created both models ...
